caption: The Grizzlies beat the Cavaliers 124-121 for their eighth straight road win, a franchise record. Taylor Hendricks sealed it with two free throws with 2.3 seconds left, and Cam Spencer scored 26.

beats.text: TAYLOR HENDRICKS SEALS IT AT THE LINE

sources.claim: Eighth straight road win is a franchise record (previous mark seven, set 2010); Cavs led 119-116 with 2:43 left; Memphis 8-2 run; Hendricks' free throws with 2.3 seconds left set the 124-121 final; Spencer 26, Hendricks 20; Mitchell 34
Road win streak of eight games is a franchise record; Hendricks 20 points including two free throws with 2.3 seconds left; Spencer 26; 22 lead changes; Grizzlies 11-4
